package tech

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// CreateTechInput holds create data.
type CreateTechInput struct {
	Label string
}

// CreateTech creates a tech label or returns existing.
type CreateTech struct {
	Techs repository.TechRepository
}

// Handle creates or returns existing tech.
func (uc CreateTech) Handle(ctx context.Context, in CreateTechInput) (domain.Tech, error) {
	existing, err := uc.Techs.GetByLabel(ctx, in.Label)
	if err != nil && err != domain.ErrNotFound {
		return domain.Tech{}, err
	}
	if existing != nil {
		return *existing, nil
	}
	tech := domain.Tech{
		Label:     in.Label,
		CreatedAt: time.Now().UTC(),
	}
	if err := uc.Techs.Create(ctx, tech); err != nil {
		return domain.Tech{}, err
	}
	created, err := uc.Techs.GetByLabel(ctx, in.Label)
	if err != nil {
		return domain.Tech{}, err
	}
	if created == nil {
		return domain.Tech{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return *created, nil
}
